description: The only copy of Housefly in existence - a long book about three individuals drawn together by fate in the early 1800s to save their English town of Victoria from a mysterious threat.  You never got to publish it, but reading it lets you forget the horrors of the Cataclysm, if only for a moment.

name.str_pl: copies of Nuclear Physics Made Easy

description: A book detailing the workings of state of the art atomic technology, and the physics behind it.
A binder containing detailed production logs from an industrial mealworm farm.  You could use its recordings to start your own farming operations.

A small folio indicating how to best utilize the equipment of your FEMA survival kit during an emergency.  Its first page urges you to remain calm, and to tune into the emergency broadcast system for further instructions.

name.str_pl: copies of Dr Moreau and You

description: A Shady Hills Corporation research binder covering mutagen design: the Killophant shock-troop program, mi-go derived strains and a chapter on reanimating the dead.  Someone gave it its title in a fit of dark humor.  Otherwise a dry text about genetic modification.

name.str_pl: copies of useful recipes for resistance

description: Recipes for Resistance is a collection of tales, strategies and recipes for working against corporate rule.  Very simple language is used in the recipes but it drags out the explanations.

name.str: Working in Boreal Conditions and Beyond
name.str_pl: copies of Working in Boreal Conditions and Beyond

description: A corporate manual for conditions of inhospitable cold.  It includes instructions for building devices and substances that will aid in survival in extreme weather or even the lack thereof.

name.str_pl: copies of Unusual Ammunitions of the Corporations

description: A Rivtech lab book dedicated to reverse engineering unusual ammunition.  Written in a format to allow barely trained technicians to *safely* replicate these rounds.

name.str_pl: copies of Applications of Arctic Lichen

description: A sheaf of XEDRA field notes detailing some species of lichen recovered near dimensional anomalies.  Most of the information is useless to you except for the fact that these lichens rely on a macronutrient that acts like a neurotoxin for humans.  One useful note is a detailed procedure to neutralize said neurotoxin.

name.str_pl: copies of Rivtech Exoskeleton user manuals

description:
A somewhat hefty manual in Russian with accompanying English text which goes in-depth into the proper usage and maintenance of Rivtech brand Exoskeletons.

While it mainly pertains to the old Rivtech exoskeletons, the knowledge within could still help out with modular exoskeletons in general.
